section_summary.extract_value: Study 2 tested whether the SBAS-2 could detect momentary changes in body appreciation by asking participants to complete the SBAS-2 after imagining brief scenarios manipulating perceived acceptance of their body by family, friends, romantic partners, or the media. The manipulation was based on prior work linking perceived acceptance from important others to body appreciation and mirrors methods used to validate other state measures.
section_summary.evidence_source: "In order to show that the SBAS-2 was capable of detecting momentary changes... we asked participants to respond to the SBAS-2 after imagining a series of brief scenarios (created for this study) that manipulated the extent to which family, friends, romantic partners or the media communicated acceptance of the participant's body."
